t: This is St Ursula's Convent School, a Roman Catholic secondary school for girls in Greenwich. It takes its name from Saint Ursula, a Romano-British virgin and martyr, possibly of royal origin. She is venerated as a saint in the Catholic Church, the Eastern Orthodox Church and the Anglican Communion, and her feast day in the pre-1970 General Roman Calendar is the twenty-first of October. The school carries her name as its patron.
